Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1217
Claimant:
Megan Gutierrez
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
01/24/2024
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection, with the insured vehicle struck on the driver's side by
a vehicle that failed to yield. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through
the attorney's office.
02/25/2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the poilcy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. Nothing in the
file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
02/27/2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and lists the same
sequence of events the claimant described at intake.
03/04/2024
Scene photographs were obtained and confirm several details of the collision. No independent witnesses have been
identified beyond the parties and responding officers.
03/27/2024
Vehicle damage on the driver's side is consistent with the reported impact angle and location. No prior damage to the
same panels is recorded in the claim history or in the photos on file.
04/10/2024
Claimant reports a shoulder injury. The kind of injury and the force involved in the crash appear to align well, and no
earlier injury to the same body area is known from the medical history provided.
04/23/2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits tapering off as the claimant's condition
improved. The claimant's account has remained the same in every conversation to date.
04/28/2024
Medical records and billing have been requested through counsel. Reserves are being reviewed against the
treatment timeline as records arrive.
05/28/2024
File remains open pending receipt of the complete medical records and the attorney's demand package. Next review
is scheduled once those documents are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
